Usage: mcpjam cloud eval trace [options]

Fetch the full trace for one eval iteration (large: full message history +
spans)

Options:
  --run <id>              Eval run ID (from `eval run`)
  --iteration <id>        Iteration ID (from `eval iterations`)
  --project <id-or-name>  Project name or ID (defaults to the most recently
                          updated project)
  -h, --help              display help for command

Usage: mcpjam cloud eval steps [options]

Per-authored-step results for one eval iteration: status
(ok/fail/skipped/pending), reason, and evidence (screenshot/video URLs). The
fastest way to see WHICH step failed and why.

Options:
  --run <id>              Eval run ID (from `eval run`)
  --iteration <id>        Iteration ID (from `eval iterations`)
  --project <id-or-name>  Project name or ID (defaults to the most recently
                          updated project)
  -h, --help              display help for command
